Title: Implement splitbrain_explain_code tool (explain what code does, not what's wrong)
Description: Most frequent IDE use case: developer pastes unfamiliar code and wants 'what does this do?' not 'what's wrong with it?' Distinct from review_code. Routes to Fast node (latency-sensitive — developer waiting at keyboard). Model: qcoder:latest (analysis, not generation). Parameters: code, language, verbosity (brief|detailed|eli5, default brief). All three sources independently identified this as the highest-value missing tool.
